notes.text:
An update is available for mariadb, module.mariadb.
This update affects Rocky Linux 9.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
MariaDB is a multi-user, multi-threaded SQL database server that is binary compatible with MySQL. 

Security Fix(es):

* pcre2: PCRE2: Out-of-bounds write allows arbitrary code execution via crafted regular expressions (CVE-2026-86145)

* pcre2: PCRE2: Memory corruption vulnerability in pcre2_jit_match (CVE-2026-89161)

* pcre2: pcre2: Out-of-bounds write via crafted regular expression (CVE-2026-103111)

* mariadb: mariadb: Arbitrary code execution via insecure service account home directory (CVE-2026-107814)

* mariadb: mariadb: Arbitrary code execution via crafted FRM metadata (CVE-2026-107821)

* mariadb: mariadb: Privilege escalation via environment variable injection during service restart (CVE-2026-107818)

* mariadb: mariadb: Privilege escalation via unescaped newlines in view parser (CVE-2026-107823)

* mariadb: mariadb: Privilege escalation via empty password in GRANT PROXY statement (CVE-2026-97380)

* mariadb: MariaDB: Numerous issues caused by historical #mysql50# tablename encoding bypass. (CVE-2026-92262)

* mariadb: MariaDB: Out-of-bound buffer write on in `ST_AsText` of nested GeometryCollections (CVE-2026-85746)

* mariadb: mariadb: SQL injection via improper identifier quoting (CVE-2026-86047)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
